Contipark page https://www.contipark.de/de/parken/braunschweig/parkplatz-hauptbahnhof-west-p3-braunschweig/ (retrieved 2026-10-08), the text in package Braunschweig_Monatstarife_2026-10-08.zip (SHA-256 72fec30d4515a3f7468af66222802697b09ae042b283adc335b5ae3607650c81), member evidence/contipark/p3.txt: 1.10 EUR per '30 Minuten' (hourly_rate_eur 2.20, billing_unit_min 30), '1 Tag' 11.00 EUR (daily_cap_eur), the monthly product '1 Monat fuer Stellplatzmieter' 74.00 EUR (the cheapest publicly purchasable monthly product, package rule BS_DB_P3_O02), commuter_day_eur 3.52 = 74.00 / 21 working days to the cent (ASSUMPTION P2). The same amounts stand in the DB BahnPark sheet of 2026-05-29 (member evidence/contipark/db_bahnpark_8000049.txt, checked). ASSUMPTION G-a: the amount is billed per started 30 min and the '1 Tag' amount is the daily maximum per stay (the pages state neither a rounding nor the day boundary). Fee window 0-24 h: the page states the car park open 00:00-24:00 and a fee table without a time limit; spec v3 B1 (2026-10-14) sources the window from the DB BahnPark station page (source id db_hbf, https://www.bahnhof.de/braunschweig-hbf/parkplaetze; package Grossparkplaetze_ZGB8_2026-10-12.zip (SHA-256 d467275ced5b68717ff2f426ad94be4debd085a9bebfaa239cfa6f4518fc9db4), member Grossparkplaetze_ZGB8_2026-10-12/evidence/braunschweig/raw/db_hbf.txt (SHA-256 c63a4bc4d2e89d977a795c41771dcf5ec57948caf0dc3a732951dd8fb8788933)): Monday to Sunday including holidays 00:00-00:00 for the three DB BahnPark car parks Nord, West and Ackerstrasse (= P2 Sued), so the mapping of the entries to the zones does not matter for the window. The page states opening hours and no separate fee hours; fee_window_source operator_page (ruling R-B-4) says that the window is read from the published page of the operator, which is no ordinance or signage. This replaces the assumption F1 of ruling R-4g-2. Named and NOT modelled: the BahnCard and Pcard discounts of DB BahnPark. Not used: 1 Woche 55.00 EUR; 1 Monat am Parkautomaten 78.00 EUR; 1 Monat fuer Stellplatzmieter (fester Stellplatz) 130.00 EUR. The stated maximum parking durations are not modelled. resident_permits_valid false: a car park of DB BahnPark; no source states that resident permits are valid there (ASSUMPTION R2-a). ASSUMPTION C-a: the zone is the area within 50 m of the lot outline. workplace_class bs_outer: the Hauptbahnhof lies in the SrV Unterbezirk Hauptbahnhof (Oberbezirk 4 Stadtteilring), as the BgA row at the forecourt; no Unterbezirk polygon is available, so this is a reading of the location (ASSUMPTION G-b). valid_from = retrieval date (the start of this tariff is not published).
